source_caption:
Heath Ledger stayed deeply in character throughout filming Brokeback Mountain, speaking in Ennis’s quiet, restrained voice even off-camera. Director Ang Lee encouraged this approach to preserve the character’s internalized emotion and tension.

Brokeback Mountain (2005), directed by Ang Lee, starring Heath Ledger, Jake Gyllenhaal, Michelle Williams. A powerful and heartbreaking romance that spans decades, exploring love, repression, and identity with quiet intensity and emotional depth.

source_details.title: Brokeback Mountain
source_details.synopsis: Brokeback Mountain is a 2005 American romantic drama film directed by Ang Lee and produced by Diana Ossana and James Schamus. Adapted from the 1997 short story by Annie Proulx, the screenplay was written by Ossana and Larry McMurtry. The film stars Heath Ledger, Jake Gyllenhaal, Anne Hathaway, and Michelle Williams. Its plot depicts the complex romantic relationship between two American cowboys, Ennis Del Mar and Jack Twist, in the American West from 1963 to 1983. Lee became attached to the project in 2001 after previous attempts to adapt Proulx's story into a film did not materialize.
